summary: ROUND 1 stabilization (MART/SHOP checkout idempotency, friendly errors, partial results, saved address book). Backend: 9 pytest cases, 8 pass. Idempotent replay works for MART and SHOP, including 3 concurrent same-id requests producing 1 order. The key is released after a failed request. address_id is snapshotted on the order. Address book default rules work and recipient fields persist. Admin and partner order lists show the order. The one failure is a minor 404 issue. IMPORTANT ENV FINDING: backend runs `uvicorn --workers 4` with NO --reload, so it is not hot-reloading. On first run, orders.py (mtime 13:41:19) was newer than the process (started 13:40:40), and the 'inline address hidden from book' fix was NOT live: an inline order address showed up in GET /customers/me/addresses. After `supervisorctl restart backend` (startup clean, all 4 workers report startup complete, advisory lock OK, health 200) the fix works. Frontend (Expo web 390x844): Flow D passes. Add Home: search 'Cocody', pick a result, location text fills, recipient/building/landmark/area are saved. Add Office: use current location (Abidjan geolocation). Then set Office as default and then Home as default; edit Office instructions and recipient; reload, data persists. Save without location is blocked. Delete with confirm removes the address. Flow A passes. Checkout preselects the default Home. Tapping it opens /addresses?select=1 titled 'Choisir l’adresse de livraison'. Choosing Office returns to checkout showing Office. With COD, placing the order lands on /order/mart/<id>. The order address_snapshot is Office (with recipient and instructions) and Home is still the default. The order is in admin /admin/modules/mart/orders and partner /partner/orders. Error UX (via route interception) passes. 502 Cloudflare HTML shows the FR friendly text (co.unconfirmed) and the POST is retried 3 times with the same client_request_id. A 400 detail message is shown as-is. MART success + SHOP 500 shows 'Confirmées : MART. Non confirmées : SHOP: …' and navigates to the MART order. Light theme renders on both new screens.

minor.issue: Deleting an already soft-deleted address returns 200 instead of 404. The UPDATE has no deleted_at IS NULL filter (shared/customer/routes.py:110-113), and it also re-stamps deleted_at.

PATCH uses the full AddressIn model (label/line1/city required), so it behaves like PUT. Sending is_default=false on the current default (e.g. unticking the toggle in the edit form) leaves the customer with NO default address. Nothing re-promotes one, unlike delete.
A replay returns only {id, idempotent_replay:true}, not the full order payload of the first response. The current app only reads .id, which is fine, but other clients may break.

When Redis is down, the fallback is per-process (4 uvicorn workers) and a 'pending' entry is overwritten instead of rejected. Concurrent retries could then create duplicates. Redis is configured and works now; a DB unique constraint (customer_id, client_request_id) would be the durable guard.
uvicorn runs with --workers 4 and no --reload, so code edits are NOT hot-reloaded. Restart the backend after every backend change. Stale code was served during this test until I restarted.

ui_bugs.issue: The one-time checkout address choice (setCheckoutAddressId) is never reset to null after an order is placed. Within the same app session, the next checkout keeps preselecting the previously chosen non-default address instead of the default. Found by code review (setCheckoutAddressId is only called in addresses/index.tsx choose()).
Number(null) gives 0, so a saved address with no lat/lng becomes 0,0. The checkout addressOk check (latitude != null) then passes. Legacy addresses without coordinates could be ordered to 0,0.
When you pick a new location while editing, line1 is kept if already set (x.line1 || p.line1). Changing the location therefore does not update the street, so the street and pin can disagree.

issues: The 'Définir par défaut' link and the 'Changer' link use lime accent text on a white card, which is low contrast. Use accentText as for the earlier 'Ouvert' badge finding.
The selected label chip (Domicile) is only a grey fill with a border, a weak selected state in both themes.
Error lines are prefixed with raw module codes 'MART:'/'SHOP:' rather than localized module names.

Module branding still shows the lowercase 'bakēd' suffix (MARTbakēd on the order screen, BrandName, AppGrid, and login.body 'Un compte. Tout bakēd.'). Alert titles use 'BAKED'. Confirm this is intended.

action_items: Reset setCheckoutAddressId(null) after a successful order (and/or when checkout unmounts) so the next checkout defaults to the default address.
DELETE address: add deleted_at IS NULL to the WHERE clause so a repeat delete returns 404.
PATCH address: prevent removing the last default (re-promote one, or ignore is_default=false on the current default).
Optional: make idempotency durable (DB unique key) and return the full order on replay.
Remember that the backend has no hot reload (4 workers): restart it after backend edits.
Light-theme contrast for the accent links on the address screens.
critical_code_review_comments: idempotency.claim memory fallback overwrites a 'pending' entry, so it is not concurrency-safe and not shared across the 4 workers.
create_order silently ignores an address_id that belongs to another customer and falls back to the inline address or a 400. Acceptable, but no explicit 404.
checkout.tsx attempt ref is never regenerated. That is fine because the key is released on failure, but after a partial success a retry reuses the same ids (intended).

success_rate.backend: 89% (8/9; the single failure is a minor 404 edge case)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows (D, A, error/partial alerts, light theme)

seed_data_creation: Fresh TEST customers via OTP: UI user +225 0701299311 (addresses Domicile/Bureau with TEST_ recipients; its 2 MART orders were cancelled; 1 SHOP item left in its cart). Pytest creates random 070129xxxx customers with TEST_ addresses and a few COD MART/SHOP orders (not cancelled). The shared 0700000000 account was not modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend has NO hot reload: check that the uvicorn start time is later than the file mtimes, or restart. Token injection: localStorage baked_access_token=<token from /app/memory/cust_token.sh with API=public url> plus baked_onboarding_done='true'. On web, confirmAsk uses window.confirm and notify uses window.alert, so accept dialogs in Playwright. Google Places search works on web ('Cocody' gives 5 results). Use-current works with the Playwright geolocation grant. Error UX tested via page.route on **/api/orders and **/api/shop/checkout.
rca of the issue: Inline checkout address appeared in the address book on the first run: the backend process was started 40 s before the orders.py edit, and uvicorn runs without --reload. Mitigation: restart the backend (done). The fix itself is correct.
